user_story: As a user, I want to submit a contact form to provide feedback so that my message can be received by the support team. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I fill in the 'Name' input (selector: 'input[name="name"]'), 'Email' input (selector: 'input[name="email"]'), 'Subject' input (selector: 'input[name="subject"]'), and 'Your Message Here' textarea (selector: 'textarea#message'), and click the 'Submit' button (selector: 'input[name="submit"]'), I should be able to submit the form successfully. 2. If I attempt to submit the form without filling in any fields and click the 'Submit' button, the page should remain at 'https://automationexercise.com/contact_us' without any field being cleared or changed.
